scheme_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojana
department: Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Maintenance allowance for students from economically weaker sections who are not availing government hostel facilities.
benefits: Monthly maintenance allowance to cover boarding/lodging for eligible students living outside government hostels.
eligibility: Family income below the prescribed limit
Enrolled in a recognized professional course
Not residing in a government hostel
application_steps: Apply through the Mahadbt portal along with admission documents
